title: Advanced Technologies in Information and Communication Technology

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand current and emerging trends in Information Technology and related career fields.
Apply advanced data processing methods in practical scenarios.
Understand and apply cloud computing principles and practices.
Understand and apply concepts of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning.
Develop the ability to generalize and solve specific problems, provide examples, and implement specific applications.
Effectively present and communicate complex topics.
Develop the ability to independently learn and understand new technologies.
Work effectively in a team environment, understand responsibilities, and adhere to professional ethics.
